title: Keep work commands working under a parent whose required child an imported folder removal cancelled on a store with no root execution
outcome: Keep work commands working under a parent whose required child an imported folder removal cancelled on a store with no root execution
acceptance: On a store whose tasks arrived by task-sync import, so its roots have no root execution, after an incoming folder removal disposes a required child as Cancelled, `engram work add X --under <its parent>` (and other work commands whose receipt lists waivable children) succeed instead of failing with 'root work … has no active execution'
A CLI test reproduces the two-host sequence: B enrolled by import, A's task file removed and committed, B imports the removal, then B adds a child under the parent
